reviewer: Claude Code (AI first-pass source audit; not an independent human curator)
scope: 1-based manifest positions 181-186 of data/validation/self_run_p0_candidates.json, frozen order; 6 candidates, 11 arms (end of the 186-candidate manifest)
blinding: self_run_p0_predictions.json and all model outputs were NOT opened. The FRDB snapshot /tmp/sisyphus-frdb-v2024-12-30.zip (SHA256 647b80d9...9c7a, verified) was read with every column containing 'cmax' dropped before any row was printed. Arms were mapped by dose, AUC, t1/2, n, sex, population and annotated-form metadata only. Original-source Cmax values were then read from original tables/text. No observed-vs-predicted comparison was made.
method_note: Single AI pass. Full originals read: PMC8167741 (pridinol, MCP full text); PMC3346613 full-text HTML (lersivirine TQT); archived PMDA interview forms for actarit (530263_1149031F1030_1_15F_1F, SHA256 303520b8...f129) and faropenem (730155_6139001R1032_1_012_1F, SHA256 e1bdb676...bc3c) via web.archive.org id_ captures, because both cited info.pmda.go.jp URLs now return 404 (actarit cited revision 14F never archived; faropenem cited revision 011 archived only as a truncated 1 MiB capture). Blocked originals time-boxed: DMD/ScienceDirect (lersivirine ADME, Cloudflare 403 also in a clean Playwright session), Wiley (butriptyline), Karger (sulfamethoxypyridazine). Only PubMed E-utilities (MCP), PMC, Europe PMC, web.archive.org and publisher landing pages were queried. No email, contact identifier or Unpaywall was used; no repository file was modified (transient Playwright logs this session created were removed).

duplicate_arm_flags: frdb_4649 duplicates frdb_4644 (same faropenem 300 mg fasted cohort, identical values)

unresolved_issues: Pridinol (2147): verified; FRDB AUC/t1/2 map to the TEST product MEDIAN values, so the matched Cmax statistic is the median 31.04 ng/mL (mean 30.71, gmean 29.27). Coordinator should fix the statistic convention.
Actarit (393): verified_with_caveat - cited IF revision 14F unavailable; 15F read. Fasted row n=16 Cmax 2.09 μg/mL. Food-study dosage form implicit (film-coated IR tablet product).

Lersivirine (8748): frdb_8714 (500 mg [14C] ADME, n=4) unverified - DMD full text blocked; frdb_8715 (2,400 mg TQT, n=48) verified_with_caveat - 8-h fast, plasma, gmean 1727 ng/mL, dosage form unstated.
Sulfamethoxypyridazine (732): unverified - 1967 Karger paper, no abstract, full text 403; free vs total sulfonamide assay unknown.

Butriptyline (2875): frdb_6312 ineligible (sustained-release). frdb_6311 unverified - abstract gives conventional-tablet Cmax 46.5 ng/mL but fasting/health status/statistic not confirmable (Wiley 403); manifest dose 75 mg is HCl salt basis (≈66.7 mg base by MW; FRDB annotation's 72.6 mg base looks inconsistent).

Faropenem (2063): 4 arms verified_with_caveat from IF revision 012 (cited 011 truncated in archive); doses are 力価 (free-acid potency) so no salt correction; frdb_4649 duplicates frdb_4644 and should be counted once; 600 mg arm is supratherapeutic and sub-proportional.

arms.reason: Mapped by AUCinf 197.11 ng·h/mL and t1/2 18 h, which are exactly the TEST-product (Myoson direct) MEDIAN AUC∞ and T1/2 in Table 2 (N=33); FRDB has no row for the reference product (Lyseen). Healthy male+female adults, overnight 8-h fast, single IR tablet (dissolution ≥98% in 15 min), pridinol in plasma by LC-MS/MS.

arms.reason: Mapped by n=48 healthy males and AUC 17,750 ng·h/mL (AUClast, geometric mean) = the Results value. Thorough-QT 3-way crossover; lersivirine 2,400 mg single dose given after an 8-h fast in its own period (moxifloxacin/placebo in other periods, ≥7-day washout, so not a combination). Plasma lersivirine. Caveats: dosage form not stated (text says only 'formulation ... similar' to the SAD study); supratherapeutic dose with sub-proportional exposure noted by authors; Cmax reported as Results-text geometric mean, no PK table.

arms.reason: FRDB annotated form 'Butriptyline hydrochloride 25mg tablet' (3 × 25 mg conventional tablets = 75 mg); AUC∞ 638.7, t1/2 19.8 h, n=14. Abstract confirms plasma butriptyline, single oral 75 mg butriptyline HYDROCHLORIDE, conventional (IR) formulation, 14 volunteers, and gives conventional Cmax 46.5 ng/mL. Not upgraded because fasting state and health status are not stated in the abstract and the Wiley full text (tables) is paywalled (403), so the statistic and whether 46.5 is observed vs model-fitted cannot be confirmed. Salt basis: manifest 75 mg is hydrochloride salt; by MW (base 293.45 / HCl 329.9) this is ≈66.7 mg base, which conflicts with the FRDB annotation (24.2 mg base per 25 mg tablet → 72.6 mg).

coordinator_review.scope: Manifest and source-audit consistency cross-check only; frozen prediction file not opened.
notes: This completes a first-pass source review of all 186 frozen candidates and 452 arms; conditional, unverified and duplicate arms still require final eligibility adjudication before scoring.

Faropenem frdb_4649 and frdb_4644 appear to be the same fasted 300 mg cohort with identical original Cmax/AUC/t1/2; count once in any scored dataset, with the retained arm ID fixed before opening predictions.

Pridinol FRDB non-Cmax metadata map to test-product medians, so 31.04 ng/mL is the matched median Cmax; retain the statistic label and assess compatibility with primary scoring convention before unsealing.
